name: archive media selector
purpose: Select an archive item to switch its full-page picture/video and reveal linked thumbnails and text.

files.archive.html: Integration partial: original feature data/markup, CDN URLs made explicitlyHTTPS, unscoped inline gap style removed (present in scoped CSS).
files.archive.original.html: Exact111214-byte user-provided feature section; includes original optional modal markup.
files.original-modules.js: Unmodified original Browserify module entries64/67/68/69/72, reference only.
files.original-styles.css: Original feature CSS with media contexts retained.
files.archive-selector.js: Standalone native-DOM selection/background/gallery controller; no automatic initialization.
files.archive-selector.css: Scoped feature CSS and required typography/reset rules.
files.archive-data.json: All21 ID-linked archive records and default background.
files.asset-manifest.json: 468 direct media URLs, provenance and successful HEAD responses plus core dependencies.
files.source-extract.json: Source locations, behaviors, dependencies, matching metrics and verification limits.

steps: Insert archive.html into the host document.
Import createArchiveSelector from archive-selector.js and mount the feature root once.
Provide your own chooser/ticker, or use select(id) to reach items outside the static strip.

options.resetControl: Optional existing button/link; no global header handlers are installed.
options.onShift: Optional callback receiving whether caption/ticker shift is active.

integration.cleanup: destroy removes listeners/timers, pauses video and restores owned visibility/carrier/root classes. Media hydration and native media attributes are one-way and remain in the DOM; this does not claim full DOM restoration.

standalone_port_scope.carrier_note: The provided port prepares a static strip; its clipping does not itself make every item reachable. Mount a chooser/marquee or callselect(id). The original ticker code and data are preserved for later integration.
adaptations: NativeDOM replaces bundled jQuery/Shopify coupling for this selector.
Autoplay rejection leaves the picture poster visible.
Closing timers and asynchronous playback callbacks are guarded against stale selection.
Optional Vimeo modal controls are hidden in the standalone port.

external_media: Images/videos remain hosted by SNEEZE/Shopify; binaries are not copied. Source availability and autoplay policy still apply.
dependencies: Standalone port has no external JavaScript dependencies.
pages: Library only; no new test route, no automatic mount, no changes to existing Pages files.
